# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in this project, please report it responsibly:

1. **Preferred:** Open a [GitHub Security Advisory](https://github.com/hhalperin/steganalysis-toolkit/security/advisories/new) (draft) so the report stays private until a fix is ready.
2. **Alternative:** Open a new issue and add the `security` label. Avoid including exploit details in the initial report; we can discuss details privately if needed.

We will acknowledge the report and work on a fix. Please allow reasonable time for a response.
